storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP EroMe Downloader makes it easy to save videos and images from EroMe.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any album or video page on EroMe, and download buttons automatically appear on each video player and image. Click the download button on any media item, or use the extension popup or right-click context menu. The extension detects all media in the album, shows available quality options for videos, and downloads content as standard MP4 files or original-format images.

It handles HLS streaming and direct video downloads automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos and images save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized EroMe subfolder.

Key features:
- Album-aware detection finds every video and image on the page
- In-page download buttons on each video player and image
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Full-resolution image downloads from albums
- Quality selection from all available video resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick video downloads
- Desktop notifications when downloads complete
- Dark-themed UI with pink/rose accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to EroMe.com and open any album or video page
3. Click the download button on any video or image
4. For videos, select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any album or video page on EroMe.com. Download buttons appear on each media item. Click the button on a video to see quality options and download, or right-click and select "Download Erome Video."

faq.question: Can I download images from albums?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects both videos and images in EroMe albums. Each image gets its own download button. Images are saved in their original format at full resolution.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the source. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with MP4 preferred over HLS.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos and images automatically save to an Erome subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you are on an EroMe album or video page. The extension needs the page to fully load before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video and image processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
